name: Contact Enrichment
description: Enriches contacts with OSINT data (LinkedIn, GitHub, Twitter). Calculates warmth_score, fit_score, sector alignment.

config.script: return {contact_id: data.contact_id, contact_name: data.contact_name, email: data.email};

const enrichment = {username_patterns: [contact_info.contact_name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ''), contact_info.contact_name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_'), contact_info.contact_name.split(' ')[0].toLowerCase()], sources: ['linkedin', 'github', 'twitter', 'instagram', 'medium', 'hackernews']}; return enrichment;

body.prompt: Score contact {{contact_info.contact_name}} warmth (0-100). Factors: previous interactions, mutual connections, shared network, response history. Return JSON: {warmth_score: int, factors: string[], reasoning: string}

config.script: const sectors = venture_matches.map(v => v.sector).filter((s, i, a) => a.indexOf(s) === i).slice(0, 3); return {primary_sector: sectors[0] || 'unknown', secondary_sectors: sectors.slice(1), expertise_depth: venture_matches.length};

steps.name: Create contact-venture fit edges in graph

body.edges: {{venture_matches.map(v => {source: contact_info.contact_id, target: v.id, relationship: 'CAN_HELP', properties: {fit_score: v.fit_score, sector: v.sector}})}}

config.subject: Contact Enriched: {{contact_info.contact_name}} - {{sector_expertise.expertise_depth}} venture fits
